profiles.target: Authorized VTC membership; access evaluated separately.

steps.proposition: Applicable criterion and version, admission mode and directory disclosure.
Proof and VP holder match; evaluate governing criterion; verdict is not uniformly admission.
Live capability and role ceiling, policy referral and execution-time recheck; not subject consent.

profiles.execution: Applicable path and required evidence established; refusal can be correct execution.
profiles.legitimacy: Community-scoped decision under governing criterion or direct-admission policy, correct subject and role; VTI-MEM-010–013.
profiles.effective: Current membership-derived access established at relying boundary, not inferred from credential delivery.
profiles.control: Automatic admission must not be rejected solely for missing administrator review; direct admission must not be treated as applicant consent.

profiles.target: Authorized termination and applicable dependent effects.

steps.proposition: Authenticated member, concrete disposition and removal result.
Community sends only after effective removal; acknowledgement is receipt delivery.
Community-admin capability and applicable confirmation gate.

profiles.execution: Correct removal authority and disposition; distinguish request acceptance from effective removal; source response timing tension remains bounded.
profiles.legitimacy: Correct relationship and authorized disposition; subject-initiated erasure not downgraded, VTI-MEM-032.
profiles.effective: Credential status and dependent enforcement evaluated at relevant time; privacy batching cannot delay credential status, VTI-MEM-034.
profiles.control: Preserve unrelated entitlements and permitted historical evidence; do not conflate group or network departure.

profiles.initial: No current permission for selected conversation/agent/scope.
profiles.target: Current scoped allow or safe non-delivery; withdrawal returns to default-deny.

steps.proposition: Context administrator binds authorized operator; routing is not consent.
Enrolled bridge holds inbound; pending challenge and prompt.
Authenticated prompt and single-use challenge; not decision.
Authorized issuer, exact subject and challenge where required; direct or bridge-attested provenance; deny is recorded too.
Scoped read and issuer-controlled change token; cache advisory.

profiles.execution: Applicable path and exact decision binding; policy-permitted preauthorization is alternative, not missing challenge by definition.
profiles.legitimacy: Current authoritative allow for exact subject and action; bridge-attested choice is not legal representative authority.
profiles.effective: Bridge enforces current permission or safe deferral; revocation is not proof of downstream refresh.
profiles.control: Recorded deny and valid preauthorization are legitimate alternative outcomes; do not infer all conversation participants consented.

limitations: Analytical profiles, not published upstream ceremony definitions.
